title: Very Fragile
text: Very Fragile. I ordered 3 boxes of these bulbs for a chandelier and of the 12 bulbs, only 8 worked, the rest had either broken filaments (3) or a broken glass support (1) for the filament. These bulbs are manufactured far far away and must travel a long distance and be handled multiple times before they arrive at my door step. I returned the broken bulbs and a new box was promptly returned (wonder service by Amazon) but the bulbs remain very fragile.
